description.en: 1. New Ashok Nagar is the second Namo Bharat station and a terminal station from Delhi end on the presently operational section of New Ashok Nagar to Meerut South. New Ashok Nagar is an elevated station. 2. Namo Bharat New Ashok Nagar Station serves areas like New Ashok Nagar, Vasundhara Enclave, Mayur Vihar Phase 1 Extension, Chilla Village, and commercial hubs such as Noida's Sector 15 and Noida Film City in East Delhi. It also caters to commuters from nearby Noida, including Sector 15. The station provides excellent connectivity for residential and commercial hubs, supported by last-mile transport options like e-rickshaws and autos, making it a key transit point near the Delhi-Noida border. 3. NH-24 (Delhi-Meerut Expressway) is accessible via connecting roads. 4. New Ashok Nagar is a Divyangjan-friendly station.

description.en: 1. Anand Vihar is the second Namo Bharat station from Delhi end on the presently operational section of New Ashok Nagar to Meerut South. Anand Vihar is an underground Namo Bharat station. 2. The station is located in East Delhi and is well-connected to the NH-9 (Delhi-Meerut Expressway) and the Ghaziabad Link Road, facilitating travel toward Ghaziabad and other parts of East Delhi. 3. Anand Vihar Namo Bharat station is situated near Anand Vihar Delhi Metro Station (Blue Line and Pink Line), the Anand Vihar ISBT (Inter-State Bus Terminal) and the Anand Vihar Railway Station. 4. Anand Vihar Namo Bharat station also connects to key spots like Pacific Mall, a popular shopping and entertainment destination. It also links to nearby areas like Vivek Vihar, Karkardooma, and Shreshtha Vihar. With its proximity to NH-9 and robust transport facilities, the station is a vital transit hub in East Delhi. 5. Anand Vihar is a divyangjan friendly station.
